errors.text: The proposed Al-induced B2 network replaces the target Cr-induced Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves network, with no direct evidence that 2-4 at.% Al produces the asserted reticulated B2 morphology in HfMoTaTiZr.
The baseline density and room-temperature fracture strain are substantially incorrect: the target values are approximately 10.44 g/cm3 and 11.6%, not 12-13 g/cm3 and below 5%.
The mechanism omits the target dual contribution from Cr solid-solution hardening, including lattice contraction, and instead treats the network mechanism as distinct from solid-solution hardening.
The Al-versus-Si comparison is chemically confounded and cannot cleanly distinguish solid-solution hardening from topology effects.
